current_instrument: SR 26-2 Revised Guidance on Model Risk Management
current_state: Issued April 17 2026; supersedes SR 11-7 and SR 21-8
applicability_boundary: Most relevant to Federal Reserve-supervised banking organizations with more than $30 billion in total consolidated assets; applicability remains institution- and use-specific
whitepaper_use: Maps evidence lineage, validation limits and human review to model-risk governance considerations
not_claimed: Conformance, regulatory acceptance or applicability to every institution

current_state: Effective July 21 2026; states that ECOA does not authorize disparate-impact liability or an effects test
applicability_boundary: Credit-decision obligations and other legal theories remain fact- and jurisdiction-specific
whitepaper_use: Uses AIR only as a voluntarily selected internal fairness-screening metric
not_claimed: A Regulation B requirement, ECOA disparate-impact liability or a lending-compliance verdict

current_instrument: Uniform Guidelines Q&A on the four-fifths rule
current_state: Employment-selection rule of thumb; not a legal definition and not controlling in all circumstances
applicability_boundary: Not a lending rule; cited only as the historical source of the 0.80 heuristic
whitepaper_use: Explains the origin and limits of the paper's internally selected 0.80 screen
not_claimed: Lending-law requirement or proof of unlawful discrimination

current_instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by the 2026 AI Omnibus
current_state: AI Omnibus entered into force July 27 2026; Annex III high-risk rules apply December 2 2027 and product-integrated high-risk rules August 2 2028
applicability_boundary: Creditworthiness use may be Annex III high-risk; role, deployment and transition dates require case-specific review
whitepaper_use: Maps data governance, technical documentation, transparency and human-oversight evidence themes
not_claimed: Conformity assessment, CE marking, provider/deployer classification or legal compliance

current_instrument: FCA Consumer Duty FG22/5 and PRIN 2A
current_state: Current FCA materials call for firms to monitor and evidence good outcomes, including across groups
applicability_boundary: Applies according to FCA perimeter, role, product and customer context
whitepaper_use: Uses group-level monitoring and evidence retention as governance support
not_claimed: Consumer Duty compliance or FCA approval
